title: XRP six-venue spot order-book depth snapshot and coverage limitations
snapshot_semantics: Fuelmaps hourly snapshot labeled 13:00 UTC. The publisher says hourly updates are published five minutes after the hour and each hourly column averages one-minute book snapshots; this is not a single instantaneous full-depth capture.

claims_supported: XRP mid price and displayed USD resting bid/ask depth at the published hourly snapshot.
Venue coverage and full-depth versus near-price venue distinctions.
Largest displayed resting levels within 10 percent of the mid, excluding the inside quote.
source_limits: One aggregator/publisher; the six underlying venues are not six independent publishers.
Binance and Bitget are excluded; the largest spot venue by volume is missing.
Displayed orders can be cancelled and hidden or iceberg liquidity is not visible.
Full-depth coverage is limited to Coinbase, Bitstamp, Bitfinex and Gemini; OKX and Kraken contribute near-price depth.
Hourly columns average one-minute snapshots; short-lived walls are diluted.
Spot only; no perpetual/futures order books.
No history is available before the publisher began recording, and past exchange books are not downloadable from the page.

raw_capture.reason: The public page exposed a rendered dashboard and its published hourly values, not byte-complete exchange API responses or transport receipts.

market_snapshot.interpretation: Displayed bid depth exceeds displayed ask depth in every published band, with bid share ranging from 53.9% to 59.7%. This is a single hourly aggregated book observation, not executable depth, persistent support, signed order flow or a directional signal.

source_independence.note: Venue books are distinct market venues, but this observation is one aggregated publisher product. The prior Kraken ticker capture at 12:30:59 UTC is not synchronized with this 13:00 UTC hourly book.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The displayed six-venue snapshot has more bid than ask depth across all reported bands, consistent with a bid-side resting-liquidity skew at the 13:00 UTC hourly window.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_observation: Published bid share ranges from 53.9% to 59.7%.
disconfirming_evidence_required: Subsequent synchronized snapshots show the bid share reverting or flipping.
Executed sell flow consumes the displayed bids without replenishment.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Displayed bid skew may not represent durable or executable demand because resting orders can be cancelled and hidden/iceberg liquidity is not visible.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_observation: Fuelmaps explicitly documents cancellation and hidden-liquidity limitations.
disconfirming_evidence_required: Time-resolved raw venue updates show persistence through price tests and replenishment after executions.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The apparent bid skew may change when Binance and Bitget are included; the snapshot is not a consolidated market-wide order book.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_observation: The publisher excludes Binance and Bitget, and only five of six venues cover the ±10% band.
disconfirming_evidence_required: A synchronized independently captured venue set including Binance/Bitget confirms a similar depth distribution.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The 12:00 and 13:00 published snapshots show materially different depth balance; the bid-side skew in the 13:00 artifact is not established as persistent.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_observation: At 12:00, bid share is 48.3% within 2% and 49.4% within 10%; the 13:00 artifact reports 56.2% and 53.9% respectively.
disconfirming_evidence_required: Synchronized raw venue snapshots show a persistent bid-side skew through subsequent price tests and executed flow.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Depth values for USDT-denominated books may move with the live USDT/USD conversion rate; the rendered methodology does not disclose the conversion source or exact conversion timestamp.
competing_hypotheses.supporting_observation: Fuelmaps says USDT books are converted to USD using a live USDT/USD rate.
disconfirming_evidence_required: The publisher supplies the exact conversion source, timestamp, and raw USDT/USD receipt; direct venue-level USD-normalized calculations reconcile.

model_eligibility.reason: Rendered hourly aggregate; original 13:00 values are not reproducible from the later direct page rendering, a separate 12:00 snapshot shows a materially different depth balance, the USDT/USD conversion source/timestamp is undisclosed, no byte-complete raw source receipt or independent timestamp anchor exists, venue coverage is incomplete, and cancellations/executed-flow linkage are unavailable.

next_actions: Capture byte-complete public order-book responses with SHA-256 and local receipt timestamps for Coinbase, OKX, Kraken, Bitstamp, Bitfinex, Gemini and Binance where available.
Normalize USD and USDT books without mixing spot and perpetual contracts.
Compute executable slippage curves and cumulative depth at 10, 25, 50 and 100 basis points.
Track order additions, cancellations, persistence, replenishment and executed trade flow at synchronized cutoffs.
Keep this hourly Fuelmaps observation as a research-only cross-check until raw receipts and venue-level reconciliation exist.
Do not issue a directional forecast from displayed resting depth alone.
Preserve the 12:00 page observation and 13:00 artifact as separate hourly vintages; do not infer persistent bid support.
Obtain the exact USDT/USD conversion source and timestamp before comparing USD and USDT books.
Prefer direct venue-level raw order-book receipts over the Fuelmaps aggregate for model admission.

publisher_page_observations.note: A later direct rendering of the same publisher page displayed the 12:00 UTC snapshot, not the 13:00 UTC snapshot recorded in the original artifact. This is a distinct hourly vintage and a reproducibility discrepancy, not a replacement for the 13:00 observation.

claims: The page says it updates hourly, five minutes after the hour.
Each hourly column averages one-minute book snapshots; a wall present for 10 minutes of an hour appears at roughly one sixth of its instantaneous size in that hourly column.
The publisher converts USDT books to USD using a live USDT/USD rate.
Full-depth venues are Coinbase, Bitstamp, Bitfinex and Gemini; OKX and Kraken provide near-price depth only, with asset-dependent reach.
Binance and Bitget are excluded because their public data cannot be read by the network the map records from.
Resting orders can be cancelled; hidden and iceberg orders are not visible; futures/perpetual books are excluded; historical books cannot be downloaded from exchanges.
limits: The page does not identify the exact USDT/USD conversion source and timestamp in the rendered methodology.
The 13:00 snapshot in the original artifact was not visible in the later direct page rendering, which showed 12:00.
The rendered page is one aggregator, not raw venue-level receipts.

snapshot_vintage_disagreement.interpretation: The two observations are different hourly vintages. The later page rendering did not expose the 13:00 values that the original artifact recorded. The 12:00 snapshot is ask-heavy at ±2% and ±10%, while the 13:00 artifact is bid-heavy across all bands. Do not call the bid-side skew persistent or combine the snapshots as one book.
plausible_explanations: The dashboard had not published or rendered the 13:00 column at the time of the later page retrieval.
The first artifact captured a publisher value that is not reproducible from the currently rendered page.
The page or retrieval layer served a cached earlier hourly snapshot.
snapshot_vintage_disagreement.evidence_needed: Byte-complete publisher API response or direct venue-level book captures with synchronized receipt times and USDT/USD conversion receipts.
